intro.title: Black keys come in groups
intro.text: Look at the black keys: they repeat in groups of two and three. That pattern is your map of the whole keyboard.

intro.title: C sits left of the two
intro.text: Every white key just left of a two-black-key group is a C. Middle C (C4) is the one closest to the middle of your keyboard.

intro.title: Middle C
intro.text: Thumb (finger 1) of your right hand on middle C. On the staff it sits on its own little line below the five lines.
